external_primary_references_checked.title: Khronos SYCL Reference: Events
validated_points: Profiling queries may block while the associated command is incomplete and require a queue created with enable_profiling.
command_submit, command_start, and command_end are nanosecond timestamps; events on the same backend share a timebase.
command_start is an action-start timestamp with no guaranteed accuracy; command_end is an action-completion timestamp.

external_primary_references_checked.title: Khronos SYCL Reference: Queues
validated_points: enable_profiling requires timestamp capture for events from that queue.
in_order orders commands on one queue and makes no ordering guarantee between different queues.

findings.title: The packed stall is observed at the second residual-bank callback drain
evidence: The captured owned-process stack reaches queueFinish through cudaStreamSynchronize from the native16 layer-major callback at layer 17, chunk row 16,384.
The checked chunk-boundary cudaStreamSynchronize returns before the callback. The callback then submits a device-to-device residual-bank copy and performs another checked queue drain.
The packed receipt is the failed/incomplete arm. The optimized receipt is one independent completed diagnostic with performance, quality, and physical 262,144-context qualification all false.
findings.interpretation: The closest source boundary is callback copy submission/retirement. Since the same in-order queue's earlier chunk drain succeeded, the stack does not locate the wait inside packed QSA math. It also does not prove the callback copy or driver is defective, and one optimized pass does not prove immunity.
findings.next_observation: Proceed with Main's already queued matched window-0/window-2 runs using optimized QSA. If a later run reproduces this callback stall, retain one compact host-only sequence for the successful chunk drain, callback copy kind/span/bytes and submit status, and callback drain result. Do not add marker kernels or a new synchronization edge. A driver-wide investigation is not supported by current evidence.

Seven observed GGUF GU/down type pairs and the relevant current source hashes match the pinned receipt.

The proposed M=1..15 branch retains the current exact GGUF-to-FP16 decode boundary, FP32 local accumulation, BF16 output rounding and existing SwiGLU/combine path, with the existing implementation from M=16.

The new value is the actual shape census, active type mix, narrowed M boundary, and explicit current-contract gate. This is not yet a source change, component result, speed claim, or adoption.

findings.title: Returned-event profiling can separate command intervals, with two bounded-plan corrections
evidence: The current vLLM native16 submission, GGUF dequant, post-op, runtime, and queue sources expose or create the events and profiled queue described in R978; the current matched configuration uses the explicit same-queue path.

The proposed arithmetic is correct for a per-chunk cap: 256 MoE GEMMs plus 32 dequant events plus 16 each for gather, SwiGLU, and combine equals 336 phase references; adding 16 upload references gives 352.
corrections: Call command_start minus command_submit the reported submit-to-start queueing interval. It can include runtime/backend queueing and device waiting; it does not by itself separate host front-end delay from device backlog. Keep host submission CPU/time as a separate clock.

An empty row-bin/layer-quartile/chunk stratum is a valid eligible=0, selected=0 observation. For sparse strata, select min(4, eligible) and record both counts. Mark incomplete only for expected census/selection mismatches, query errors, failed retirement, cap overflow, or wrong queue.

R978 says weight-copy sampling is at most 16 across the request, but its 352-per-chunk and 1,760-record totals treat 16 as a per-chunk cap. Choose one: keep 16 request-wide and lower the request record ceiling to 1,696, or explicitly allow 16 per chunk and retain the 1,760 ceiling. The 352 per-chunk guard remains safe either way.
findings.interpretation: command_end minus command_start is a backend-reported action interval, not EU occupancy, utilization, useful work, DRAM/cache traffic, or PCIe wire traffic. Submit-to-start is also not a utilization measure. A bounded diagnostic can prioritize service-versus-queue/host hypotheses only after calibration and observer-perturbation checks.
